title: Sequence Models
tagline: Recurrent networks, LSTMs, sequence-to-sequence models and the invention of attention
summary: Language unfolds in time. This course models sequences with recurrent networks, meets the difficulty of long-range dependencies with LSTMs and GRUs, builds sequence-to-sequence models for translation, and introduces attention — the idea that became the Transformer.

chapters.title: Recurrent neural networks
chapters.summary: Recurrence, unrolling, backpropagation through time and neural language models.

chapters.title: LSTMs and GRUs
chapters.summary: Vanishing gradients through time, gating, the LSTM and GRU cells and gradient clipping.

chapters.title: Sequence-to-sequence models
chapters.summary: Encoder–decoder architectures, teacher forcing and machine translation.

chapters.title: Decoding
chapters.summary: Greedy and beam search, length normalisation and exposure bias.

chapters.title: Attention
chapters.summary: Additive and multiplicative attention, alignment, and attention as a soft dictionary lookup.

chapters.title: Contextual embeddings
chapters.summary: ELMo, transfer learning and the move from static to contextual representations.

chapters.title: Convolutions and state-space models
chapters.summary: Temporal convolutions, linear recurrences and state-space models such as S4 and Mamba.
